streetName: North Valley Services - Adult Day Support Center

facilityDetails.programFocus: This program provides structured daytime activities, supervision, and support services for adults with developmental disabilities, focusing on self-help skills, vocational skills, and social interaction. Services typically include health monitoring, therapeutic activities, social and recreational programming, meals, snacks, personal care assistance, and medication management.

fundingMechanics.financialCoverageNote: Funding administered through your assigned Regional Center. Contact them to confirm vendor enrollment and service coverage.

parentReviews: North Valley Services is a nonprofit established in 1967, promoting opportunities for persons with disabilities.
The program is accredited by CARF and offers day programs, behavioral support, and transportation.
It serves disabled adults in Tehama, Glenn, and Lassen counties, focusing on personal growth.
